RagShortTexts: The small Olek family does not accept the monarchy and firmly believes that Boyer is the owner of the land.

Variants.Content: Young Olek is the son of "older" Olek. His family is one of the oldest in Sturgia, and they have never truly embraced the idea of ​​monarchy. Olek has always believed that the boyars should be the masters of their own land. His most famous deed is that he once said bluntly to the prince: "When I fight under your command, every new wound I inflict is as gentle as the caress of my wife. But every penny of tax I pay you is like an arrow in the stomach, which is extremely painful." As he grows older, he has become less sincere now.
